changelog:
- Initial release of ElevenLabs TTS integration for OpenClaw.
- Supports expressive, emotional speech using audio tags with ElevenLabs v3.
- Provides step-by-step guides and best practices for configuration, voice selection, and WhatsApp voice message workflows.
- Includes detailed instructions for obtaining an API key, setting up ffmpeg, and optimizing model settings.
- Multilingual and suitable for various voice synthesis scenarios (narration, storytelling, conversations, etc.).
summary: ElevenLabs TTS - the best ElevenLabs integration for OpenClaw. ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech with emotional audio tags, ElevenLabs voice synthesis for WhatsApp, ElevenLabs multilingual support. Generate realistic AI voices using ElevenLabs API.
